cells.requirement: A landlord must have one of 17 permitted just cause reasons to evict a tenant from a covered rental unit, and mere lease expiration does not qualify. Certain no-fault evictions, such as owner move-ins or Ellis Act withdrawals, require landlords to pay specified per-tenant and per-unit relocation assistance.
The annual allowable rent increase for rent-controlled residential units is 1.6% for the period from March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.
Landlords are prohibited from using software or algorithmic devices that analyze non-public competitor rental data to recommend rental prices or manage occupancy levels for residential units.
Landlords must pay interest on tenant security deposits at an annual rate of 4.2% for the period from March 1, 2026 to February 28, 2027.
